title: Mapo Tofu
description: Soft tofu in a fiery, savory Sichuan sauce of chili bean paste, a little ground pork, garlic and tingling Sichuan pepper.

image.alt: A bowl of tofu cubes in a red chili sauce with green onion

steps.text: Slide the tofu into a pot of gently simmering salted water for {time 2 min}; this firms it so it holds together. Drain carefully.
Heat the oil in the wok over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the pork until browned and crisp at the edges, {time 3-4 min}.
Lower the heat to medium, add the chili bean paste and fry until the oil turns red, {time 1 min}. Add the garlic and ginger for {time 30 sec}.
Add the broth, soy sauce and sugar and bring to a simmer. Slide in the tofu and simmer gently, nudging rather than stirring, for {time 3-4 min}.
Stir the cornstarch with {qty 2 tbsp} water, pour it in and swirl the pan until the sauce thickens and turns glossy, {time 1 min}. Sprinkle with Sichuan pepper and green onions and serve with rice.

notes: For a vegetarian version, replace the pork with finely chopped mushrooms and use vegetable broth.
